title: Knockout Crunchy Canadian Hazelnut Pancakes
description: A pungent and crunchy Canadian dish featuring Nutella, with a light and fluffy texture from lamination-puff, perfect for a delicious breakfast, garlic and onion free.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, hazelnuts, sugar, and baking powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Fold in the Nutella until a marbled effect is achieved.
Let the batter rest for 10 minutes to allow the flour to absorb the liquid.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot with your favorite toppings.
